integrity: The proof is an exhaustive exact factorization argument. The prime-power inverse formula is independently derived from the local generating series and cross-checked against the recent primary source. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem identifies the maximal connected open parameter interval containing \(t=0\); it does not classify every parameter outside \((-2,1)\). The finite verifier is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Sharp parameter interval for the exceptional ordinary Dirichlet-inverse prime criterion
